example-walking.title: Back on your feet
example-walking.description: From shoes by the door to a daily walk after lunch, one small step at a time.
example-walking.why: Why do you want to walk more? In your own words.
example-walking.shoes.action: put my walking shoes by the door
example-walking.shoes.arrival: The path starts at your own front door.
example-walking.shoes.accept: Your shoes are waiting. Next, you could take them for a short walk.
example-walking.shoes.nugget: Small enough to do on your worst day: that is what makes a first step stick.
example-walking.walk-5.arrival: The street outside feels a little more familiar.
example-walking.walk-5.accept: Five minutes became easy. You could try a longer round.
example-walking.walk-5.nugget: Missing one day is fine. What matters is coming back the next time.
example-walking.walk-15.arrival: A longer path, and something grey blocks the view.
example-walking.walk-15.nugget: On a hard day, you could go back to 5 minutes. It still counts as showing up.
example-walking.ending: You walk after lunch now. It is part of your day.
